# Cindy IM transport

Source: https://github.com/makecindy/cindy/tree/bfb95c3492e8732497e08d296c8baeae04971e8f/packages/lizi-im

Copyright XD Inc. and Cindy contributors. Licensed under Apache-2.0; see LICENSE.

MyCode reuses this standalone local transport package. The host adapter is implemented separately in runtime/im-bridge.ts. Cindy cloud registration, account discovery and official Telegram relay are not exposed by this adapter. The upstream source and attribution are preserved.
